notes: Night shift: 'work on <project> tonight: ...' codes on a copy from 00:30; in the morning you get a summary and the changed files to keep (old ones backed up) or throw away. Self-repair: every night at 03:30 (or 'check yourself') Jarvis reads his own errors, fixes the safe ones (stuck jobs, huge logs, old copies) and explains the rest. Camera eyes: 'look at this' opens the camera (the back one on your phone); while it's open, every question includes what it sees.
